name: AI Research Assistant
description: A document-grounded research workspace with semantic search, cited answers, paper analysis, and multi-paper comparison.
summary: A user-owned PDF library connects document preparation to retrieval-grounded research. Saved sessions, paper reports, and comparisons retain citations so the supporting text can be inspected.
architecture: Next.js calls a modular FastAPI backend. PyMuPDF extracts page text; document services chunk it and an embedding provider indexes it in PostgreSQL with pgvector. OpenAI and LangGraph support grounded research workflows with saved steps and citation snapshots. Report export and OCR remain planned.

capabilities.name: PDF library
capabilities.description: Upload, extract, chunk, index, and manage user-owned papers.

capabilities.name: Grounded research
capabilities.description: Answer questions and save sessions with page-level citations.

capabilities.name: Paper comparison
capabilities.description: Generate structured single-paper analysis and compare two to five indexed papers.

stack.usage: App Router pages expose the document library, research history, paper reports, and comparison workspace.
Typed frontend models describe documents, citations, and research responses.
Authenticated routes manage owned documents, indexing, sessions, and analyses.
Python services coordinate extraction, chunking, retrieval, and grounded reporting.
Page-by-page extraction preserves page attribution for document chunks and citations.
The PostgreSQL vector extension stores chunk embeddings and supports similarity search.
The database stores user-owned documents, chunks, sessions, and analysis records.
Provider abstractions use OpenAI embeddings and the Responses API for cited answers when configured.
LangGraph coordinates research steps with persisted step and citation snapshots.
ORM repositories enforce data access for research and document records.
Compose provisions a PostgreSQL image with the pgvector extension.
Backend tests exercise ownership, document processing, and research workflows.

architectureConnections.description: Extracted text is chunked, embedded, and indexed for retrieval.
Retrieved paper context grounds model-generated answers.
Workflow steps and citation snapshots are persisted.

evidence.notes: Reviewed the local ai-research-assistant checkout README and dependency manifests, with its configured GitHub origin.
